description: The file defines the SavedModel type and contains functionality to load a saved TensorFlow model from disk, including interfacing with C libraries and protobufs.

classes.name: SavedModel
classes.description: Represents a loaded TensorFlow SavedModel, including session, graph, and signatures.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents a TensorFlow session (referenced within SavedModel).

methods.name: LoadSavedModel
methods.description: Loads a saved TensorFlow model from a directory, initializes a session, and returns a SavedModel instance.

methods.name: generateSignatures
methods.description: Converts protobuf signature definitions into Signature objects.
